category_title: Mature students with depression and insomnia focused on vocational progression
scenario_title: Procedural error during a cooking task
minimal_context: Colin is participating in a specialized cookery course where he needs to chop onions and add them to a recipe at the right time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, please chop the onions and put them in at the right time for the recipe.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not sure when they go in... I have a fear of failure and I'm worried the other students will laugh at me if I make a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, just follow the instructions on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Colin looks down at the onions, feeling embarrassment about asking for help. He stares blankly, exhausted from severe insomnia and depression.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, I am talking to you. Why are you just standing there?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You really showed me up! I didn't realise you were talking to me. That done it for me. I'm leaving and I'm never going back.

TUTOR: Colin, please chop the onions and put them in at the right time for the recipe.

STUDENT: I'm not sure when they go in... I have a fear of failure and I'm worried the other students will laugh at me if I make a mistake.

STUDENT: You really showed me up! I didn't realise you were talking to me. That done it for me. I'm leaving and I'm never going back.

task.content: chop the onions or put them in at the right time
task.learning_goal: gathering different recipes and eating more healthily

context.social_setting: with 'their own people' (i.e. people who also had mental health difficulties)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher was talking to him and he didn't realize
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: dropped out of the class and never went back
related_quotes: Apparently the teacher was talking to me and she really showed me up as I didn ’t realise. That done it for me. I never went back

behavior_patterns.condition: When making mistakes during the learning process
behavior_patterns.internal_state: fear of failure and fear of being laughed at by other students
